Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment used iTRAQ 4-plex (per ProteinPilot parameters) or 8-plex (per PRIDE metadata) for relative quantification of BALF proteins after immunodepletion of high-abundance proteins. The acquisition mode is explicitly DDA.

scope: To decrease the dynamic range, we enriched the medium and low abundance proteins by selectively immunodepleting the fourteen most abundant proteins in the concentrated samples on Seppro IgY 14 spin columns
The unbound medium and low abundance proteins were collected in the flow through.

Enriched medium and low abundance proteins (50 µg from early-phase survivors and non-survivors, 25 µg from late phase survivors) were digested by trypsin and labeled with iTRAQ reagent (AB Sciex, Foster City, CA) for mass spectrometric analysis.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The material analyzed by MS was the flow-through from an immunoaffinity depletion process (Seppro IgY 14 spin columns) used to enrich medium and low abundance proteins from bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF). This constitutes an affinity-purified/interaction-enriched material scope.
